params.val: picks up an item that an ADJACENT Pokémon used up THIS turn (not any past turn), chosen at random if multiple qualify, if the holder currently holds none

verified via Showdown source: strictly "used it up this turn" and "adjacent" — not any used/Flung item from anywhere earlier in the battle, which the previous wording implied. Also has a separate post-battle-only pickup chance, out of scope for an in-battle event model.
